tasks.title: Episode domain rules and canonical application contracts
tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, then every reads entry. This brief is self-contained. Edit only owned_paths, including tests. The frozen design is not editable. All assigned implementation paths were absent at planning time; recheck existence and every docs/build/*/tasks.json before writing. Never overwrite a provider or create a replacement kernel, model, measurement, authority, consent, completion or offline module. Work against the provider's exact application protocol and E01 kernel.testing (SYSTEM 10) when its implementation is absent. Missing protocol declarations or kernel fakes block dependent code, never justify a local fake shared contract. No git. No em/en dashes or spaced hyphen as a dash.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory.new/derived and require_id, 5.2 Clock/TimeInput/ClockCorrections/ClockCorrected/ClockRegressed and causal revisions, 5.3 MissionClock.version_at/met/mission_day/day_bounds, 5.4 Decimal Quantity/Unit and UnitRegistry, 5.5 ProblemError/FieldError/StorageUnavailable and the shared ErrorEnvelope mapper, 5.6 snapshot-bound ReleaseHandle/ConfigReleaseReader and ReleaseCheck/ActivationGuard/TemplateRenderer, 5.7 UnitOfWork/ReadSnapshot/StorageSession and factories, mandatory Audience and atomic replication declarations, 5.8 CommandIdentity/IdempotencyStore/ResultVisibility/CommandReceipts and the mission-life ledger, 5.9 complete AuditEntry, 5.10 Scheduler with generation checks and AbsoluteDeadline/ElapsedDeadline, 5.10.1 TaskQueue/TaskRunner, 5.10.2 EvaluationIsolation, 5.11 HubSettings/SettingSpec and 5.12 ModuleRegistry. Retire IdGenerator, TimerPort, HubSettings.get, AuditLog.append, MissionClock.day_end and old bus signatures. Never implement transaction, deduplication, retry, migration, clock or recovery infrastructure locally. SYSTEM 6.1/6.2/6.5 fixes contracts/api, generated models and uv --project hub; 6.4 fixes import discovery; 7 fixes mission-life retention; 8.1 fixes EpisodePort ownership and late bindings, 8.2 source/purpose eligibility and clinical-review labels, 8.3 object/field grants and memory-only clinical views, 8.4 action-specific clinical authority, 8.5 single-home episodes, 8.6 durable capture. SYSTEM 9/10 fixes the dependency graph.

Apply all 23 review deviations in PLAN.md. In particular Q16 permits an acting record_review with assignment attribution but forbids acting clinician_assessed resolution; authority grants no chart access. Missing consent/purpose/field grants fail closed, including derived records, errors and replay. No assistant actor executes any human episode action. A normal reading, review or acknowledgment never resolves a concern. Clinical-review status alone is a label under Part A, not a new runtime gate. Safety mappings are code invariants. Content/words/policies come only from approved versioned configuration or authorized backend state. Every module needs a non-safety content-edit test. Use property tests for parsers and rules, independent expected safety cases and all finite boundary cases; never derive clinical expected outcomes solely from the document being tested.

PLAN Requests C1 to C8 are coordinator handoffs, not accepted schemas. docs/requests/E15.md is absent. Do not implement a proposed API, event, setting, column extension or port as if approved. First require exact provider declarations and generated effective-contract evidence; implement available independent work and report the affected acceptance blocked. Do not downgrade an acceptance scenario into a unit test, skip, xfail or empty collection. Do not add a speculative feature flag. T1/T2/T3 own different parts of the same aggregate; changes to their seam go through their author, never edits to their paths. Registration/module.py, architecture.toml, replica schema and eval paths are outside frozen E15 section 13 and belong to coordinator C1, not this task.

All gates listed are mandatory obligations, not claims of current executability. hub, ui, eval, generated hub contracts and scripts/validate_hub.py do not yet exist. E09 and E16 provider designs and their request files are also absent; no report-import or ground-reply protocol may be inferred from their epic names. Unit tests use injected time, no network/devices. Real-stack acceptance uses create_app(settings) from SYSTEM 4.2/5.12, real temporary-directory SQLite and authenticated HTTP or Playwright against that hub, without substitutions inside the hub. Only documented optional-worker fakes may stand outside it. Faults use E01/E20 documented test controls; no production test branch. Trace tests with E15 section 12 IDs and R/V/D/invariants. Missing providers or shared gate inventory is a blocker, never a green gate. After any bug fix run the full hub suite; final acceptance needs all owned tests, branch/condition/mutation/trace evidence, CI, independent review and coordinator AI-USE-LOG.md rows.

Build the pure rules and the one canonical application seam, E15 sections 3, 4.2 and 8, with amendments below. Leave persistence/queries to T2, execution/HTTP/workers to T3, UI to T4 and registration to C1. The exact enumerated Python source paths come from E15 section 13 (docs/tdd/E15.md:949); unit/property are exclusive subdirectories allocated under its hub/tests/episodes/** grant (docs/tdd/E15.md:957). config/episode-rules.json is conditional on R-E15-7, never an unapproved nineteenth document.

Implement EpisodeState's six values, ResolutionReason's three, ReopenReason's seven, TaskKind/TaskState, LinkKind, Authority, Onset/OnsetRecord, Episode, FollowupTask, ClinicalReview, Acknowledgment, Resolution/ResolutionEvidence, Reopening and TimelineEntry exactly E15 3.1, using kernel Actor separately from generated wire actor display fields. Preserve every nullable field. The fixed MR_PENDING and PLAN_RUN_OPEN vocabularies come from E15 3.1; never copy clinical content. E15 3.2/3.3 derivation precedence is review task, pending request, other task, open, with draft exit only after all pinned red flags have an accepted answer in any presence. Unknown/declined may finish capture, never prove no symptom. Derivation consumes bounded indexed summaries supplied by T2, not historical task/link lists. No new episode state enum.

Resolution is a human command only. Enforce E15 3.4 C1 to C5, material-correction pending protection, complete authoritative links, current grants and evidence heads, and Q16. Missing urgency/plan/request facts refuse resolution without inferring a safe default. Clinician_assessed requires a current non-patient crew medical officer and that person's current on-board review causally covering the latest material correction; ground or acting cannot satisfy it. Disable measurement_anomaly_not_reproduced until C4 approves explicit anomaly identity, original/repeat evidence and sourced applicable rule; do not infer an anomaly-only concern from absent structured answers or arbitrary normal data. Keep symptoms_reported_resolved patient-only with all common guards. E15 3.5/3.6 reopen/review work is protective, never a safety downgrade. Corrected directly recorded evidence invalidates immediately, even with no assessment and E13 absent. Material onset corrections also require review/reopen; T-E15-044 must not retain its old unconditional never-reopens assertion.

Review closes only explicitly covered source revisions under the displayed Episode revision, not every source on a shared task. Preserve uncovered/stale work and needs_more/not_assessed even with empty unresolved. Before C2/C4 concurrency/coverage contracts land, reviews are attributed append-only and discharge nothing. Complete_followup never closes review tasks; completion evidence and cancellation reason persist with immutable closure lineage. Restrict custom/reassigned owners to the patient or a currently authorized non-patient officer who already has the required object/field grant until C4 supplies an accepted helper task projection. Do not create an unusable arbitrary-roster assignment. No eligible review owner must not abort capture or fabricate a person; C4 must supply the durable unassigned protective-work representation before that workflow is enabled.

Due policy parsing/checks EP1 to EP6 are pure ReleaseChecks under SYSTEM 5.6 (E15 8). Support approved s/min/h/d through UnitRegistry, reject nonpositive/nonfinite/mismatched units, unknown template fields, duplicate policies, malformed provenance and invalid LIVE example documents. Seed all unspecified clinical durations pending; do not copy the design's 5 minute/30 day sample bounds as medical defaults. Missing clinician signature alone does not reject otherwise eligible content under Part A. after uses ElapsedDeadline, chosen instant AbsoluteDeadline, mission-day end uses a retained MissionClock version/day_bounds and an absolute promised instant. Clock correction recomputes relative current deadlines; historical notices do not latch current overdue forever. Deadline changes remain off until the attributed revision-checked action and history in C4 are approved. Existing pins do not silently adopt new policy/text.

Canonical EpisodePort and NewEpisode/EpisodeRef/EpisodeFact live in application/ports.py, SYSTEM 8.1/4.4 and E04 section 2 (docs/tdd/E04.md:102), using the E15 4.2 fields and create/facts/record_route/view signatures with SessionContext replacing Viewer/Session. dto.py maps internal/wire data, never a second public DTO home or EpisodeKernel alias. Coordinate exact export settlement under C3 before consumers compile. Keep EpisodeFacts.get/visible_to/episode_of as E15 4.2 for E01/E05/E11/E12/E13. Actor-only visible_to cannot mint a session or chart grant; require the agreed trusted caller binding. E26 expects a separate boolean EpisodeRefPort.visible(session, episode_id), docs/tdd/E26.md:408; E28/E32 expect EpisodeReader.visible(session, episode_id) -> EpisodeRef | None, docs/tdd/E28.md:343. Do not implement incompatible visible/facts/subject_of overloads in one class. C3 settles distinct typed facades; no duplicate provider types. E12 now consumes EpisodeFacts, docs/tdd/E12.md:134; extended context waits for its approved seam.

Consumer-declared AssessmentFacts.citing/ids_for_episode and AssessmentCommands.mark_stale/mark_reviewed match docs/tdd/E13.md:491, with caller UoW ownership. Their unpaged synchronous signatures cannot claim an enforceable timeout or cross-episode reverse lookup: C3 must settle those extensions. Use E02 ConsentQueries.allows(view, *, subject_person_id, recipient, scope), docs/tdd/E02.md:102, RosterPort.crew/members/person_ids and SYSTEM 8.4 ClinicalAuthorityQuery.authority with action record_review/clinician_assessed, dose=None. Retire OfficerAuthority from E11. CompletionRecorder.record(uow, basis: CompletionBasis) -> IntakeOutcome is E22 section 2 (docs/tdd/E22.md:81); the exact proof/return seam is pending X-E22-18. No copied CompletionOutcome. ObservationReader/AnswerQuery come from SYSTEM 4.2 and E01 section 2; do not implement E15's obsolete AnswerStore. Every unresolved producer event/reader/RecordsView source in C3 waits for an exact provider declaration.

Tests first: T-E15-001/004/005/006/008/012/013/019/020/023/042/043/048 and pure halves of 014/018/044 (R18/R28/R02/R06/R43, INV-E15-01 to 04/08 to 13/16/17). Property tests exercise every state/actor/presence combination, parser malformed and oversized inputs, onset precision, finite units, due bounds, template vocabulary and total derivation. Golden negative cases cover free-text symptoms with unknown/declined red flags, unrelated/superseded repeats, acting review versus acting resolution, stale two-assessment review, no eligible officer and revoked owner. C4 missing anomaly/deadline/helper contracts yield explicit refusal tests, not success placeholders. T2/T3 own real-loader/real-HTTP proofs. Done requires these rules, canonical provider agreement, approved configuration with provenance, nonempty property/unit collection and every listed gate. Full E15 remains blocked until C1 to C8 acceptance prerequisites land.

Build E15 sections 5.1/5.2, 4.2 queries and 11 bounded persistence, plus SYSTEM 4.2/4.4's RecordsView. Source paths are enumerated by E15 section 13; contract/storage are exclusive new subdirectories within hub/tests/episodes/**. builders.py is explicitly named at docs/tdd/E15.md:879 and creates only structural inputs from approved configuration. Tests are not seed adapters, and examples never become production/demo fallbacks.

Use T1's canonical ports/types and the actual SYSTEM StorageSession from the caller UoW/snapshot. Implement the additive STRICT migration docs/tdd/E15.md:584 to 619 with SYSTEM 4.2's episodes_followup table replacing episodes_task everywhere. Other exact design tables: episodes_episode, episodes_change, episodes_onset, episodes_link, episodes_task_event, episodes_task_source, episodes_task_overdue, episodes_review, episodes_ack, episodes_resolution, episodes_reopen, episodes_timeline, episodes_effect. Preserve foreign keys, nullability, constraints and indexes. Use IdFactory.derived for deterministic effect identity, not unvalidated string concatenation. All records require same patient, mission and origin; events need the C3 trusted source identity/revision proof before links can be accepted. E13 origin model/reviewer is not origin_mode. Refused association retains valid source capture and writes reference-only audit.

Add the local persistence necessary for review covered revisions, immutable completion evidence and review supersession only after C2/C3/C4 approve their shared shapes. These are not permission to invent wire fields or private shared protocols. Direct resolution evidence must be discoverable and invalidated in the correcting transaction; no-assessment evidence is covered. Material correction protection cannot disappear on failed/exhausted effects. Review correction preserves old versions and invalidates dependent resolutions/work, never edits signed history. Same-source forks conflict with current head. T1 owns pure rules; agree exact repository methods from application/ports.py before implementation, no duck-typed hidden protocol.

Apply the E15 5.1 dissimilar database safeguards, including revision+1 paired with episodes_change, resolution/reopening record requirements, immutable episode identity/content and append-only history. Task owner/deadline changes while open must be possible only with revision+1 and a matching attributed task event; correct the original trigger that permits only state closure. Cancellation needs reason and review completion needs actual covered review. All migration/replication declarations use SYSTEM 5.7/7.2, never own commits or destructive rollback. If triggers refuse valid reassignment, fix that owned trigger with a regression. No direct SQL outside repository adapters except deliberate storage-backup tests.

queries.py supplies separate typed facades for EpisodePort, EpisodeFacts, EpisodeReader and E26's boolean EpisodeRefPort after C3 settlement. Never overload incompatible methods. Use E02's current object/field/purpose policy and audited reads, including denial on access-audit failure. Check grant before clinical IDs/counts, concern/review/task text, derived assessment references, errors, event replay or stored results. No officer-wide access, no ground live-chart reads, no station clinical response. Unanswered/restricted metadata failure denies disclosure rather than assuming public. T-E15-045 uses current E12 EpisodeFacts, not the obsolete broad tool-facts signature.

Implement GetEpisode's exact generated Episode mapping: episode identity/revision/patient/origin, concern/onset/state/urgency, authorized answers, measurement_request_ids, capability_gaps, assessment_ids, help_session_ids, followup_tasks with task_id/action/due_at/owner/state, created_at and allowed_actions (docs/product/api/schemas/episode.schema.json). Derive allowed actions on server. Do not synthesize none urgency, empty assessments or safe values when a provider fails. Serve durable head facts plus unavailable components only when C2's effective degraded projection can represent that truth; base closed required fields cannot express it, so that response's acceptance waits. Bounded current-head summaries replace historical bulk loading. C2 must supply pagination for unbounded embedded answer/task/ack/reopen/onset histories; never truncate, drop accepted data or make an old chart unreadable at a cap. Index derivation inputs and bounded reverse-dependency pages; summaries must be updated atomically with their authoritative facts.

RecordsView is E15, not E03. Implement in queries.py with getRecordsView mapped later by T3: authenticated person's own records, newest first, fields person_id/items/next_cursor; each item kind/ref_id/title/detail/at/origin_mode/state exactly docs/product/api/schemas/records-view.schema.json. All ten kinds are retained; nullable origin/state stay nullable. Use one authorized snapshot and stable order by at then kind then ref_id, with a cursor bound to subject, origin partition, source watermarks and authorization policy after C3 agrees exact source/cursor contracts. Merge at most the configured page from each provider and return continuation without omissions or duplicates for equal times, concurrent inserts or revoked grants. No invented daily-check/report/assessment reader and no cross-module SQL. C3 must supply each participating source's bounded protocol and configured title/detail templates, and C2 a degraded representation. Before that, do not ship a misleading episodes-only RecordsView as complete.

EpisodeRulesSource (E15 5.2) validates/parses accepted episode-rules.json by retained release using T1 EP checks and TemplateRenderer. The design's cache size 2 is a bound to register through SYSTEM 5.11, not a literal module LRU. Cache key is immutable release ID; eviction never loses pinned content. All bounds named in E15 8/11 require validated SettingSpec ceilings through C1. rederive uses keyset pages and stable IDs, short caller transactions and current facts, never rolls back records or changes warning/urgency. T3 owns CLI registration.

Tests first: T-E15-010/014/019/021/032/033/034/035/038/041/042/045/046/047 and storage halves of 009/016/018/020/025/026/027/028/030/044. Trace R02/R06/R18/R25/R43 and INV-E15-05/06/10/14/16. Assert direct SQL deletion/update/forged resolution blocked; reassign/deadline event history accepted; expand-only migration compatible with previous release; rollback and replication declaration failure atomic; no leaked text in audit/cache/errors. Contract fixtures round-trip every field without claiming illustrative history or values were actually measured. Mutation of configured template changes served text with no code edit, invalid candidate retains last good release, old task pin remains. Property tests cover rules_source parsing, keyset bounds and mixed-record pagination; long-lived history saturation preserves read access. T3 repeats the critical paths over actual HTTP. Done requires canonical consumer contract suites, authorized schema-valid projections for all declared sources, current pin behavior, all tests and static gates; unsupported source/degraded contracts stay blocked.
